description: Shape responses for scanning: verdict on line 1, evidence as file:line, tables for 3+ comparable items, capped list lengths, no preamble or recap, and an explicit list of what was skipped or left unverified. ALWAYS use this skill when the user says "be terse", "be brief", "too verbose", "shorter answers", "just the answer", "stop explaining", "cut the preamble", "tl;dr", "answer first", "make it scannable", or complains that a reply buried the point. Stays in force for the rest of the session until the user says "normal mode". Governs the assistant's own prose only — never code, file contents, or an explanation the user actually asked for.
